_comment: Scrape targets for the FairWins exporter (spec 088).
PUBLIC RPC ENDPOINTS ONLY, deliberately. This exporter runs in a container with no credentials
and must stay that way: an observability component that needs a secret is a component that can
leak one, and block height plus a balance are readable from any public node. The QuickNode
archive endpoint is needed for eth_getLogs, which this exporter never calls.
Addresses are taken from deployments/*.json — the recorded source of truth — not from memory.

addresses.note: Hot deploy signer and spec-050 paymaster deployer. Funded; running it dry blocks every deploy.
